cc:Work.dc:title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next DSpark Prefix reranker versus Baseline training loss and accuracy
cc:Work.dc:description: Raw exported train/loss and train/acc, without smoothing, through step 18630 (the smaller final step). Latest wall-time records are used for duplicate steps. Baseline loss is L_base; jointly trained Prefix reranker loss is L_base + L_rank.
